about: Which checks cover which files. node checks/run.mjs --changed reads this; a file no rule matches runs everything. Smoke entries are pieces of a section title in checks/smoke-shell.mjs (node checks/smoke-parallel.mjs --list shows them); "*" is every section, or every Node check.

model.covers: schema v4, migration, saved-resume files, every recipe byte-identical to before 0.5.1, render hash inputs

store.covers: undo, autosave, folder mirror, backup, checkpoints

paginate.covers: block pagination, Fit on the last page, labels, photo, fields

shell.covers: layout maths (sidebar, rail, page centred, pages side by side, a phone), click targets, Esc, folder read back

camera.covers: the canvas camera: limits, the magnet, which page is bright, the spring

edit.covers: version numbers, edits, off/keep, sections, 300 random edits

motion.covers: motion rules: tokens, one reduced-motion rule, nothing blocks, the thirteen moments wired

direct.covers: the model behind editing on the page: cut-off, parked edits, lines only on one resume

resumes.covers: autosave, snapshots and sends, frozen text, new, duplicate, compare, folder

focus.covers: tags, plan = apply, Keep untouched, no job emptied

lang.covers: the ten languages, missing texts, switching, A4 formats

diff.covers: the merge engine on an edited copy of the example

import.covers: every kind of file, JSON Resume round trip, outside edits

savefile.covers: Save to file: format, record id, the ways a file meets this browser, conflict copies

export.covers: the HTML page, plain text, JSON Resume, pre-flight

tokens.covers: theme tokens: forms, refusals, DTCG round trip, contrast

career.covers: the record's model and forms, the checklist folds, job types, the Highlight lens

i18n.covers: every catalogue: keys, placeholders, plurals, markup, the review marker

tokens-built-in.covers: the built-in themes' token files are up to date

parts.covers: the panels' markup unchanged by the shared parts; a claim opened from the page or the checklist is one panel

measurement.covers: page-fill arithmetic, the data-section marker, the probe's coverage

version.covers: package.json, sw.js and CHANGELOG.md name the same version

name.covers: the old product name only in released changelog entries and kept identifiers (CI runs it on _site)

validate-data.covers: the schema guard on the example record

to-jsonresume.covers: the JSON Resume export still works

drink.covers: the app's own tokens in Tea and Coffee, contrast, no colour outside a token block

preload.covers: index.html preloads the modules shell.js imports, and sw.js caches them

csp.covers: Content-Security-Policy: same-origin only, no inline script, no outside fetch

preflight.covers: preflight refuses embedded image metadata and a prototypes/ folder

history-scan.covers: history-scan reads commit messages, authors and committers

private-files.covers: the private check files are found outside the repo, or not at all

prepush.covers: the pre-push hook refuses private content and dry-runs the site for main

agent.covers: the agent workflow on the example: claims, new-resume, refusals, fit, the keyword gap

fit.covers: Fit's invariants on a modelled page

flatpak.covers: the Flatpak files agree: id, version, sandbox, cargo sources, workflow

desktop.covers: the desktop staging copy list is whole

tauri-folder.covers: the Tauri folder object against a fake window.__TAURI__

i18n-review.covers: the translation review sheets: the CSV, and --apply on a temporary copy

runner.covers: this map's globs and plan, the smoke runner's sharding and merge

head-check.covers: name card, name window, rail and foot in ten languages, both drinks, three window sizes: nothing covered, cut or overlapping

room-check.covers: the sidebar and the layout around the page: hidden share of the body, nothing too wide, the page filling the height

label-fit.covers: every language's resume headings fit the gutter; the app's new labels fit the 340px sidebar

garden-check.covers: the tea garden in Chromium (about two minutes)
